Honeybee By The Sea by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Honeybee By The Sea is a newly constructed 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath home in the Highland Parks neighborhood of Blue Mountain Beach. Grayton Beach, Seaside and WaterColor are a quick car ride or enjoyable bike ride away, with plenty of local shops and eateries. Across the street, your family will love the impressive lagoon/resort-style pool. Enjoy the hot tub, waterfall, outdoor fire pit, grilling area, TV, and a 360-degree observation tower where you can take in the views of the area, including the Gulf. The first level is a roomy, open area, with a flat-screen TV, and plenty of seating. The full kitchen, with new appliances, is ideal for preparing a large meal or a snack for the beach. The first level is also home to a primary bedroom, king, with a dual vanity and a walk-in shower. Ideal for the young crowd to relax and unwind, a cozy loft, with comfortable seating and TV, is on the second level, as is a primary bedroom, king, with private bath.

A Jack and Jill bath is shared between a guest room, queen, and a bunk room with 2 twin bunkbeds. While staying at Honeybee By The Sea, your honey can be at the beach, pool or anywhere your honey wants to bee. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 1.1 miles to the beach (Blue Mountain Regional Access) - Across the street from the resort-style pool and cabana - 4 bedrooms, 3.5 bath - 2216 sq ft - Wi-Fi - 3 bikes included Overnight: - King in 1st floor primary bedroom; private bath - King in 2nd floor guest bedroom; private bath - Queen in 2nd floor guest bedroom; shared Jack and Jill bath - 2 twin bunk beds in 2nd floor guest room; shared Jack and Jill bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
